lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm₂Ga₄Rh₄ (Sm(GaRh)₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group Cm (No. 8), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Rh centers with 9 neighbors (1 Ga, 8 Rh), and Sm centers with 20 neighbors (8 Ga, 12 Rh), while the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ga-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ga- and Sm-centered polyhedra.
